REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JULY 13, 2017 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT HELD ON JULY 13, 2017,
IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD
AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Brenda Cabrera, Assistant City Clerk.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was given by the City of Cerritos Youth Soccer League
  Rookie Division III Team, “Green Machine.”

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in
  attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  None.

5B.  Consideration of appointments to Commissions and Committees (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to appoint Tracy
  Winkler to the Fine Arts and Historical Commission for a two-year term effective July 13,
  2017 through March 31, 2019 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

5C.  Consideration of appointment of private sector representative to the Board of
  Directors of the Southeast Los Angeles County Workforce Investment Board
  (COUNCIL).

  No action was taken on this item.
 City of Cerritos  July 13, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 6

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  C. W. Vander Linden spoke regarding the Cerritos tree maintenance district map
  and tree trimming schedules.

  Sam Desai spoke regarding a green city initiative.

  Ram Kakkar spoke regarding tree maintenance and overgrown roots.

  Paul W. Bellenbaum spoke regarding the California lottery and surveys.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of June
  19, 2017 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of June 19, 2017
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of Registers of Demands

  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated July 13,
  2017 (COUNCIL).

  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated July 13, 2017 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the
  Registers of Demands as follows:

  1. City of Cerritos  July 13, 2017  $ 7,838,318.20 (COUNCIL)
  2. Successor Agency  July 13, 2017  $ 1,054.00 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  July 13, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 6

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  Approval of the Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending May 31, 2017
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the
  Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending May 31, 2017 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING VARIOUS SECTIONS OF THE CERRITOS
  MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO THE CREATION OF AN EXPEDITED PERMITTING
  PROCESS FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING STATIONS, IN CONFORMANCE
  WITH CALIFORNIA STATE ASSEMBLY BILL 1236 (2015), HEREIN REFERENCED AS
  DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2017-4 (COUNCIL).*
  *Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Noting there were no further members of the public who elected to speak, the Mayor
  closed public comments and the public hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Approve Development Code Amendment 2017-4, making the findings set forth in
  Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. 2017-20; and
  2. Waive full reading of and introduce Ordinance No. 1013, AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING VARIOUS SECTIONS OF THE
  CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO THE CREATION OF AN
  EXPEDITED PERMITTING PROCESS FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING
  STATIONS, IN CONFORMANCE WITH CALIFORNIA STATE ASSEMBLY
  BILL 1236 (2015), HEREIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE
  AMENDMENT 2017-4 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  July 13, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 6

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for Shoemaker Avenue Street
  Improvements, Bid No. 1306-17 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Yokoyama, to:

  1. Award a contract in the amount of $628,171 for Shoemaker Avenue Street
  Improvements (total bid), Bid No. 1306-17, to All American Asphalt and reject
  the other bids; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any project-related
  change orders (COUNCIL).
  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:
  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for ongoing electrical
  maintenance for the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Award contracts for ongoing electrical maintenance for the City of Cerritos to
  Harry W. Dantema of Cerritos and Sutton Electric of Mission Viejo; and
  2. Reject the proposal submitted by Parallel Electric of Long Beach (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration and award of Bid No. 1305-17, printing of the Cerritos
  Center for the Performing Arts 2017-2018 Fall and Spring Postcards (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Laurie Kajiwara, Public Information Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.
 City of Cerritos  July 13, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to award Bid No.
  1305-17 for the printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2017-
  2018 Season Fall and Spring postcards to Advantage Mailing, Inc. in the amount
  of $15,200.00. In the event issues of non-performance arise, the project would
  be removed from Advantage Mailing, Inc. and taken to the next lowest bidder to
  ensure the City’s printing deadline, quality standards and specifications are met.
  This process would be repeated as necessary in order of the lowest bid to the
  highest (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration to designate a voting delegate and alternate for the
  League of California Cities Annual Business Meeting (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Brenda Cabrera, Assistant City Clerk.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Yokoyama, and seconded by Pulido, to appoint
  Councilmember Jim Edwards as the voting delegate for the League of California
  Cities Annual Business Meeting to be held on Friday, September 15, 2017
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9E.  Review and consideration of changes to the 2017 City Council/Successor
  Agency meeting schedule (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Brenda Cabrera, Assistant City Clerk.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  No action was taken on this item.
 City of Cerritos  July 13, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 6 of 6

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Edwards, Yokoyama, and Solanki,
  Mayor Pro Tem Pulido, and Mayor Hu.

12.  Closed Session

  12A.  PERSONNEL MATTERS PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA GOVERNMENT CODE
  SECTION 54957.6: CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Agency Negotiators:  Art Gallucci, Vince Brar, Patricia Leyva,
  and Charles Goldstein
  Employee Organization:  AFSCME, Local 619

  12B.  PERSONNEL MATTERS PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA GOVERNMENT CODE
  SECTION 54957.6: CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Agency Negotiators:  Art Gallucci and Charles Goldstein
  Unrepresented Employees: Full-Time Exempt

  The City Council met and discussed the closed session items and provided
  direction to the city negotiators.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 10:30 p.m. in memory of Mr. Shuja Taj, father of
  City of Artesia Mayor Ali Taj.
